**Coaching note:**

When you give check and win material *without* losing anything, always look for follow-up threats. Here, capturing the h3 pawn with check forces the knight to h2 (the only legal move), which opens the g-file and g2 for your queen—immediate checkmate. The key: a forcing sequence that doesn't allow your opponent time to create counterplay.
